faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIM Amritsar Research Associate recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the Research Associate position at IIM Amritsar is 02-10-2026. It is advisable to apply well in advance of this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Research Associate post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Master Degree with significant research experience from a recognized University or Institution. A Masters in Human Resource or a Ph.D. is considered desirable.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Research Associate position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Research Associate position is 40 years. Age relaxation will be provided as per Government of India norms where applicable.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Research Associate role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated remuneration ranging from Rs. 26,000 to Rs. 35,000 per month.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Research Associate post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the Research Associate position at IIM Amritsar.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for the IIM Amritsar Research Associate recruitment is strictly online.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for the Research Associate position?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the Research Associate role?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Research Associate position will primarily involve a Personal Interview.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The Research Associate position at IIM Amritsar is on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and apply online?
faq.answer: You can find the official notification and the online application link in the 'Important Links' section of this article. The official website of IIM Amritsar is also provided there.
